name: City Council Meeting; Special

CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

  To the Members of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City
  Council to take place at City Hall, 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA
  at 11:00 a.m. on Saturday, January 7, 2017. The agenda for the special meeting with the
  items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.

  Posted by the Office of the City Clerk on Thursday, January 5, 2017, at 5:00 p.m.

  January 7, 2017
  11:00 A.M.
  Council Chambers of City Hall
  340 Palos Verdes Dr. West
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Copies of applicable staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business
referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public
inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council
after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s office
during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may
call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and
documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to
persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please
contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a
disability-related modification or accommodation.

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA; SPECIAL MEETING
January 7, 2017
  1
 The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings;
however, to allow for the orderly progression of the discussion, each person wishing to
comment or make a presentation shall be limited to a total of two (2) minutes for the
combination of all topics on the agenda for discussion. Anyone wishing to address the City
Council is requested to fill out a green speaker’s card available at the entry of the meeting
room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute
preparation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council,
may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
